title: The true power of regular expressions (2012)
summary: A technical blog post by Nikita Popov exploring the theoretical foundations and true capabilities of regular expressions, likely discussing what regex can and cannot parse compared to more powerful formal grammars.
problem_solved: Explains the theoretical limits of regular expressions and why complex patterns require more powerful parsing techniques.
why_valuable: Helps developers understand when to use regex versus proper parsers, preventing common misuse of regular expressions for tasks beyond their formal capabilities.
